blurb: Snow physics, slab fracture, avalanche dynamics, forecasting, defence structures and rescue at graduate level.

pics.alt: Black-and-white photograph of smashed railway cars and uprooted tree trunks in avalanche debris at Wellington, Washington, 1910
pics.caption: Wreckage of a Great Northern Railway train in the debris of the 1 March 1910 avalanche at Wellington, Washington, which killed 96 people. Note the snapped conifer trunks carried in the debris.
pics.title: Train wreckage from Wellington WA avalanche cph.3b13980.jpg

pics.alt: A person crouching in a snow pit, cutting a column of snow out of the pit wall
pics.caption: An observer in a snow pit isolates a column of snow from the pit wall to assess avalanche risk. Column tests of this kind (CT, ECT, PST) probe how easily a buried weak layer fails and whether a fracture propagates.
pics.title: Avalanche testing snow pit.JPG
